q1.sampleAnswer: We should avoid drinking and eating before our workouts.

keyPoints.descZh: 避免饭后立即锻炼/进食

q1.rubricZh: 要点：不要喝醉（酒后）；不要刚吃完饭就用器械。
q1.explanationZh: 通知里有两条：喝醉不能用器械，刚吃完饭也不能用，所以锻炼前要避免喝酒和进食。

evidence.quote: Do not use any equipment if you are drunk.
Do not use the equipment shortly after having eaten.

q2.explanationZh: 通知说 Weight lifting 要和朋友或教练一起做，所以是举重。

evidence.quote: Weight lifting should be done with a friend or trainer.

q3.sampleAnswer: Because we can use our phones to call for help in case of difficulty or emergency.

keyPoints.descZh: 遇到困难/紧急情况时用手机求助
examples: to call for help in case of difficulty or emergency

q3.rubricZh: 要点：遇到困难或紧急情况时可用手机求助。
q3.explanationZh: 通知说锻炼时带手机，是为了遇到困难或紧急情况时能打电话求助。

evidence.quote: Carry a mobile phone when exercising to call for help in case of difficulty or emergency.

q4.sampleAnswer: We are supposed to return all equipment to its place and wipe it down.

examples: return all equipment to its place

q4.rubricZh: 要点：把器械放回原位；把器械擦干净。
q4.explanationZh: 倒数第二条说用完要把器械放回原处并擦干净，两点都要答。

evidence.quote: Please return all equipment to its place and wipe down equipment after use.

keyPoints.descZh: 回答 No，不能独自使用

q5.rubricZh: 要点：No, he can’t.（17 岁属于 18 岁以下，须有成年人陪同。）
q5.explanationZh: 最后一条说 18 岁以下的孩子必须有成年人陪同，17 岁的男孩不能独自用。反意疑问句的回答看事实：不能，就答 No。

evidence.quote: Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult.

q6.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think so. The safety notice makes sure that people in the gym can use the equipment in the proper way. This can prevent injuries and accidents from happening. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

examples: It can prevent injuries and accidents.

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：先表明态度，再给出合理理由。
q6.explanationZh: 没有唯一答案：先说必要或不必要，再用一两句话讲理由，比如能防止受伤和事故。

evidence.quote: Please use the equipment in this gym in a safe and responsible way at all times and remember these points:

q7.explanationZh: 空后是 the heavy suitcase，空格作谓语；原句没有时间提示，两种时态都可：carried 或 carries。

q8.explanationZh: be moved by 表示“被……感动”，I was deeply moved by the story.
q8.tipsZh: move 的 -ed 形容词表示“感动的”

q9.explanationZh: Breakfast 是第三人称单数，usually 表示一般现在时，所以用 includes。

q10.explanationZh: 空格在名词 clouds 前，要用形容词 distant（远处的）。

q11.explanationZh: look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接动名词 returning。
q11.tipsZh: look forward to doing sth. 期待做某事

q12.explanationZh: my 后面要用名词，responsible 的名词是 responsibility；face up to 后可指多项责任，官方答案用复数 responsibilities。

q13.explanationZh: 祈使句的被动用 should + be + 过去分词，否定为 shouldn’t be worn：Jewellry shouldn’t be worn during your workouts.
q13.tipsZh: 祈使句改被动常用 should be done

q14.explanationZh: 祈使句的否定形式后面接的反意疑问句，常用 will you：Do not lean on the equipment, will you?
q14.tipsZh: 祈使句的反意疑问句用 will you

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是时间（before ...），对时间提问用 When，再接助动词 will：When will temperature be taken?

q16.explanationZh: 主语是 Foods and drinks（或 Drinks and foods），后面用被动否定 are not allowed，再接 in the gym：Foods and drinks are not allowed in the gym.
q16.tipsZh: be allowed in … 被允许在……
